entities.summary: Özgenur Yurtdagülen, a.k.a. Özge Nur Yurtdagülen, is a Turkish female volleyball player. She is 192 cm (6.30 ft) tall at 73 kg (161 lb). Currently, she plays for Galatasaray in the middle blocker position. Yurtdagülen is a member of the Turkey women's national volleyball team.
